about: a skin is cut in nine and drawn with g:image src, at most 9 calls: corners keep their size, the top and bottom edges stretch across, the left and right edges down, the middle both ways; a box narrower than both edges shares its width between them (left gets size * left // (left + right)) and blocks of size 0 are left out; a skin whose image was released shows nothing of it (the canvas refuses those calls) and still gets its text
